lines.text: Claude Code in one terminal. Codex in another. And you in the middle, copying context between them all day.
lines.spoken: Claude Code in one terminal. Codex in another. And you in the middle, copying context between them all day.

lines.text: You paste the goal, the error, what the other agent decided. The agents write the code. You do the routing.
lines.spoken: You paste the goal, the error, what the other agent decided. The agents write the code. You do the routing.

lines.text: SpecWithCode is a free Mac app for the coding agents you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, Antigravity and Pi. It takes the routing off your hands.
lines.spoken: Spec With Code is a free Mac app for the coding agents you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Open Code, Copilot, Antigravity, and Pi. It takes the routing off your hands.

lines.text: Add a project over a real folder. It gets one coordinator: a conversation that routes and tracks the work, while worker threads write the code.
lines.spoken: Add a project over a real folder. It gets one coordinator: a conversation that routes and tracks the work, while worker threads write the code.

lines.text: Describe the work once. Quick questions it answers itself. Code changes, long research and tool work go to worker threads it starts.
lines.spoken: Describe the work once. Quick questions it answers itself. Code changes, long research and tool work go to worker threads it starts.

lines.text: Here it started two workers: Claude on the greeting, and Codex on the CI workflow, because the ask named Codex. Each one gets a card and a link.
lines.spoken: Here it started two workers: Claude on the greeting, and Codex on the C I workflow, because the ask named Codex. Each one gets a card and a link.

lines.text: Follow-ups go to the worker already on that area, so nothing is assigned twice. When a worker finishes, its report comes back on its own. No polling, no pasting.
lines.spoken: Follow-ups go to the worker already on that area, so nothing is assigned twice. When a worker finishes, its report comes back on its own. No polling, no pasting.

lines.text: The coordinator and the workers have separate models. Keep the coordinator on Claude Opus 5.5, set a default worker model, or name one in the ask, like Codex here.
lines.spoken: The coordinator and the workers have separate models. Keep the coordinator on Claude Opus five point five, set a default worker model, or name one in the ask, like Codex here.

lines.text: The usage chip shows one ring per subscription, amber at 80 percent, red at 95. If one runs out, the thread offers to continue on another signed-in provider.
lines.spoken: The usage chip shows one ring per subscription: amber at eighty percent, red at ninety-five. If one runs out, the thread offers to continue on another signed-in provider.

lines.text: For bigger work, the Plan holds a short spec, acceptance criteria and tasks, and who owns each.
lines.spoken: For bigger work, the Plan holds a short spec, acceptance criteria and tasks, and who owns each.

lines.text: A worker can report a task done. Only you make it Verified: Run verification runs its check and keeps a receipt.

lines.text: The agents write the code. The coordinator routes it. You review the results.
